subject.title: fix(parallel): resolve env search key refs

question: Does the mocked dispatch path faithfully prove production Parallel SecretRef behavior, or must this PR show a redacted real gateway request using an env-backed SecretRef before merge?
rationale: The patch aligns structurally with the shared SDK, but production secrets are documented as eagerly resolved before runtime requests and the contributor lacks credentials for the live external path; maintainer intent is required to accept an override or require live proof.

options.title: Require live gateway proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate until a redacted gateway run sends a real Parallel request with an env-backed SecretRef and shows the expected result.

options.title: Grant a scoped proof override
options.body: Accept the request-header and zero-call dispatch tests after the Parallel owner confirms that the injected config represents the production resolved-config boundary.

recommendation.title: Require live gateway proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof gate until a redacted gateway run sends a real Parallel request with an env-backed SecretRef and shows the expected result.

likelyOwner.reason: The Parallel feature introducer is the strongest available owner for confirming whether the test harness represents the provider’s production credential path.
